messages:
maya (AE): Hey team — Lyra (enterprise fintech) just returned their RFI. They want the capability matrix + written answers by EOD tomorrow. Key asks: on-prem HSM support, quantized model performance (INT8/4bit), POC acceptance criteria, pricing tiers for Dedicated vs Hosted, and a sample SOW for a 3-week POC. Attaching their RFP PDF: https://files.lyra/RFP.pdf

devin (SE): I can own the POC bench. For quantization we have internal perf numbers; will need to run a short microbench against their prompt set. Do we have an existing INT8 profile for Llama-2-13B? If not, I can export and run tomorrow morning.

rachel (Solutions): I'll draft the capability matrix CSV + short narrative. Proposed columns: Feature, Redwood Supported?, Remarks, Version, Notes. Quick sample snippet below:

```
Feature,Supported,Notes
HSM/KMS,Yes,"HSM via customer BYOK + KMS integration; HSM on Dedicated only"
INT8 quantization,Partial,"We support 8-bit quantized runtime on NVIDIA A10/A100; recommend Dedicated for production"
SLA (p99 latency),Yes,"Dedicated: configurable p99; Hosted: best-effort, SLOs available on paid tiers"
```

devin (SE): For POC acceptance I propose these checkpoints — 1) latency <= 300ms p95 for 512 tokens on a Dedicated reserved pool; 2) correctness: >=90% pass on their eval set; 3) stable throughput: 200 req/s sustained for 30m with <2% error rate. If Lyra agrees we can bake these into the SOW.

maya (AE): Good checklist. Also we should surface the cost delta: hosted per-token vs Dedicated commit. Rachel — can you add a sample pricing table (example numbers) to the matrix so procurement has something concrete?

rachel (Solutions): Will do. Sample pricing rows I'll include: Hosted PAYG (per-token + embedding), Dedicated monthly commit tiers (small/med/large) + overage rates, Private deployment licensing and support fee.

tom (Legal): On the security/residency asks — we have the standard DPA and can offer EU-only residency for Private. On HSM: we support customer-managed keys (BYOK) and HSM integrations for Dedicated; on-prem installs will need a scoped addendum re: export controls. Also note Lyra asked for 7-year retention of audit logs — that's an enterprise add-on, will require SOC/arch signoff.

ops-bot: Uploads: /attachments/lyra_rfp.pdf, /attachments/lyra_eval_prompts.csv, /templates/dpa_redwood_v3.pdf, /templates/sow_poc_3w_sample.docx

devin (SE): Perf run scheduled 08:00 PT tomorrow. I'll run INT8 vs FP16 on a reserved A100 slot with their eval prompts and post latency/throughput + memory numbers.

rachel (Solutions): Draft matrix uploaded: https://redwood.internal/attachments/lyra_matrix_v1.csv :thumbsup: I included the feature support column and short written responses for each RFI line.

maya (AE): Thanks — I'll assemble the RFI package (matrix + written answers + SOW + DPA) and send to Lyra legal before EOD. Devin/Rachel/Tom, please ping here once you've added final artifacts.

tom (Legal): Quick note — mark the 7-year logs as optional concession and include estimated cost impact in SOW.

devin (SE): Perf results posted: https://redwood.internal/results/3691234567_perfs.html — INT8 gives ~1.2x speedup, memory down ~30%, p95 for 512 tokens = 260ms on Dedicated A100. Will attach CSV with raw runs.

maya (AE): Perfect — pulling everything together now. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
